heading: FAQs
copy: Do you have any questions? Check here.

questions.heading: Do I need to have a clear idea, or can you help me define it?
questions.copy: You don’t need to have everything fully defined. You can share anything from a concrete description to an emotion or memory you’d like to capture. The more details and references you provide, the closer the result will be to your vision. At Auralis, collaboration is essential to transform a spark of inspiration into a fully realized world.

questions.heading: How does the commission process work?
questions.copy:
Idea description: Fill out the contact form with your proposal. If needed, I will ask additional questions and then provide a document with all the project details. Once everything is confirmed and the deposit is made, the process begins.

Sketch approval: I will send you an initial sketch for review and approval. This stage is where adjustments to composition, poses, clothing, or other overall elements are made. It’s important to finalize major changes here, as later adjustments may involve an additional cost.

Revisions and updates: Throughout the process, I will share progress updates so we can review the artwork together. The goal is to shape a piece that reflects your vision as closely as possible.

Final delivery: You will receive the completed artwork in high resolution, ready for digital use or print. Delivery is made via email or another method previously agreed upon.

questions.heading: How long does it take to complete an illustration?
questions.copy:
Each piece is unique, and the timeline depends on complexity, level of detail, and the type of service requested. As a general guide:

Portraits: 1–2 weeks.

Landscapes: 1–2 weeks.

Character design: 2–4 weeks.

Full scenes or covers: 2–4 weeks.

These timeframes may vary depending on workload and project scale, but you will always receive an estimated delivery time before the commission begins.

questions.heading: Can I commission a character based on myself, my pet, or my OC?
questions.copy: Yes. Whether it’s a portrait of you, your pet, or an original character, I can bring them to life within the world of Auralis.

questions.heading: Can you adapt your style to different aesthetics?
questions.copy: My style has its own essence and narrative, but there is flexibility to adjust it in order to align with your vision. Together, we will find the balance between your idea and the artistic identity of Auralis.

questions.heading: How much does an illustration cost?
questions.copy:
Every project is unique, and pricing is based on your requirements, the level of detail, the type of commission, and the estimated time. For an exact quote, you can contact me directly. As a reference, prices typically start around:

Assets: from 5 USD.

Portraits: from 20 USD.

Landscapes: from 30 USD.

Character design: from 50 USD.

Full scenes or covers: from 70 USD.

questions.heading: How are payments made?
questions.copy:
I offer two payment options to suit your needs:

Single payment (recommended):

The total amount is paid once all commission details are confirmed. This option streamlines the process and allows me to share progress without watermarks, so you can see every detail as the artwork evolves.

Partial deliveries:

1. Before starting the sketch: 20% of the final price.

2. After sketch approval: 50% of the final price. (Progress updates during this stage will be watermarked as a guarantee).

3. Once the remaining balance is paid: final delivery of the artwork in high resolution.

Payment methods: PayPal, Payoneer, MercadoPago, and bank transfers. If you require another method, please feel free to ask.

questions.heading: Do you offer refunds?
questions.copy: No. Since each piece is fully customized and requires dedicated time and effort, refunds are not available. However, there are revision stages throughout the process to ensure the final artwork meets your expectations.

questions.heading: Is the artwork for personal use only, or does it include commercial rights?
questions.copy: By default, illustrations include a license for personal use only. If you wish to use the artwork commercially (for books, video games, merchandise, etc.), this must be specified during the commission process. A commercial license is available for an additional fee.

questions.heading: Can I request modifications after the artwork is finished?
questions.copy: Yes, post-delivery changes are possible but will incur an additional fee. To avoid extra costs, it is best to finalize all major adjustments during the sketch phase.

questions.heading: In what formats will I receive the illustrations?
questions.copy:
All artworks are delivered in high resolution, ready for print or digital use.

- Available formats: JPG, PNG, PDF (upon request).

- Color modes: RGB or CMYK.

- Resolution: 300 dpi.

If you require a specific size or format, you can request it during the commission process.

questions.heading: Do you offer physical prints or only digital deliveries?
questions.copy: At the moment, I only provide digital deliveries.

questions.heading: Do you work with international clients?
questions.copy: Yes. Auralis is an open space for dreamers worldwide.
